story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price ITC to move about ±4.6%, roughly 292 to 320. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 69% of the time.

Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap +0.7 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for ITC: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.
ITC futures trade 1.4 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 5.2% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
ITC has actually been moving about 1.42% a day this past month: normal for it against the past year.

iv.simple: Options on ITC are priced for moves of about 1.24% a day. That is normal for ITC compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 19.7%: 50th percentile of 1 year, 31st of all days since 2019-01-01.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much ITC has actually been moving: they price 19.7% a year while the last month realised 22.5%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -2.9 vol points, 41st percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 73% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Longer-dated options on ITC cost more than near ones: the normal, calm shape.

skew.simple: Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap +0.7 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for ITC: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal +0.69 vol pts (front month), 85th percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.simple: ITC has actually been moving about 1.42% a day this past month: normal for it against the past year.
realised.analyst: RV21 22.5% (62nd percentile of the past year), RV5 23.7%, RV63 27.8%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 54th percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 310 (+1.7% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 300 (-1.5%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.54; all-expiry OI PCR at the 50th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +3,363,750, puts -510,600 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: ITC futures trade 1.4 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 5.2% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +1.4, annualised carry 5.2% (29th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.4%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Short build-up, Long build-up, Short covering, Long unwinding, Long unwinding. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.simple: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price ITC to move about ±4.6%, roughly 292 to 320. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 69% of the time.
move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 4.61% (forward 306.0). Scored on 1,942 days since 2019-01-01 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.

notes.text: ITC has used 15% of its market-wide position limit (the ban starts at 95%).
Lot size changes from 1,725 to 1,975 for the 2027-01-25 contracts (the exchange has already listed them so).
